correctness.rationale: In the half-plane Laplace representation the squared norm is a constant times ∫|g(t)|²t^(−β)dt (Hardy boundary Plancherel at β=0). Dilation sends g(t) to s^((1−β)/2)g(st); logarithmic weighting therefore gives unitary translation and its Fourier multiplier is the stated symbol. It is nonconstant analytic, so every level set is null. Continuity identifies the essential range with the closure of the image, and on nonatomic L² every shrinking open preimage around a spectral value permits orthonormal approximate null vectors, excluding Fredholmness. Torus orbit density or periodicity gives the annulus or the analytic curve of area zero. The radial square is b²+c²+2bc cos Δ with uniform Δ in both cases; the resulting arcsine CDF differentiates to the stated radial density. The irrational law is rotation invariant, giving the stated planar density by division by 2πr; the case b=c has no atom at the center. The null Fourier modes in the rational law form the lattice generated by (p,−q), so a nonconstant matching mode requires total degree at least p+q. For the (p,q) moment the opposite generator cannot fit the unequal factor budgets, giving precisely b^p c^q. By coprimality the orbit is the full kernel of pθ−qφ modulo 2π. Parallel lifts give angular half-spacing π/√(p²+q²), and the image map is √(b²+c²)-Lipschitz. Mixed polynomials are uniformly dense on the compact support, giving weak convergence. The atom at 1 is absent when a=0; 'positive' describes the measure and does not assert a positive-semidefinite operator.
residual_risks: Recorded finite moment and radial checks are not proof of the all-parameter assertions; the Fourier, torus and geometric arguments above supply the required generality.

evidence: Writing W=b exp(iqt)+c exp(ipt), the scalar locked-versus-independent discrepancy compares the real projection of the two frozen laws, with b=A/4 and c=B/4 in the scalar record. At degree d=p+q that projection has defect 2^(1−d) binom(d,p) b^p c^q from the two conjugate mixed moments. The three-frequency record instead tests phase effects in even moments, and the inspected Pan et al. comparison uses special three-term supports.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The scalar resonant threshold is actually shared, not just similarly named. Projection alone is not a statement of the full complex value law or its spectral support. In this positive-coefficient setting even the lower-degree mixed moment equalities are closely linked: each defect is nonnegative, so a vanishing scalar defect forces all defects of that degree to vanish. Do not count use of the primitive relation itself as independent novelty.

value.rationale: This gives an explicit operator family in which every radial observable misses the difference between a full planar spectral support and a zero-area spectral curve, and even low-degree nonradial moments can miss it to arbitrarily high order. The exact radial law and metric approximation rate explain how the singular laws and spectra approach the irrational ones. That distinction is more informative than listing the symbol range or the scalar resonance on its own.
residual_risks: The value law is not a normalized operator trace. The Hausdorff constant is an upper bound and no optimality claim is established.
